g.text: DEVOPS POWER GRID SCADA & CONTINGENCY CONSOLE
Simulate sudden atmospheric front shifts along the 330 kV transmission corridor (Clear Sunny → Convective Thunderstorm).
Acute Differential Trip & Ferranti Surge Risk
Ferranti Guardrail: >340.0 kV triggers Shunt Reactor alert.
Governor Droop: 4.0% • Rotor Inertia Constant H: 4.5 s
330 kV Bulk Line 1 (Ikeja West – Oshogbo Corridor)
330 kV Bulk Line 2 (Ikeja West – Oshogbo Corridor)
OPERATOR DISPATCH REMEDIAL ACTION PLAYBOOK (CLOSED-LOOP RESTORATION)
SCADA INTERLOCK: ALL REMEDIAL SEQUENCES ARMED
Arrests Severe Turbine Rotor Overspeed (>51.00 Hz)
SCADA SEQUENCE OF EVENTS (SOE) AUDIT LOG
Doppler radar reports convective front approaching Oshogbo corridor at 42 km/h.
330 kV Bus Voltage nominal at 330.2 kV; Synchronous frequency steady at 50.02 Hz.
Circuits 1 & 2 balanced; Line differential relays (ANSI 87L) armed with zero active alarms.
